title: Logspace many-one reducibility
statement: For Boolean languages $B$ and $C$, say that $B$ is logspace reducible to $C$ if there is a function $f$ from Boolean lists to Boolean lists that is implicitly computable in logarithmic space and, for every Boolean list $x$, $x$ belongs to $B$ if and only if $f(x)$ belongs to $C$.
